HOSTING_IDLE_CODES.description: The hosting codes of the idle dimension, hosting.idle.*: what libomx-clap answers about its hold of the CPU idle states (/dev/cpu_dma_latency) while a plugin is active. The dimension is this library's: the hold lives in it, for every host that links it (#296).

oneOf.title: idleHoldRefused
oneOf.description: the device could not be opened for writing (no permission, or no such device): the host runs with no hold
oneOf.x-text: The CPU idle-latency device could not be opened for writing, so the host runs with no hold on it. Grant write access to /dev/cpu_dma_latency, or accept that idle states are not held.

HOSTING_WINDOW_CODES.description: The hosting codes of the window dimension, hosting.window.*: why omx-clap-host refuses to show a plugin's own window (clap.gui) when show_external_ui asks for it (#180). The dimension is the standalone host's: the console never shows a plugin's native window.

oneOf.title: windowNoDisplay
oneOf.description: no display to show it on: none is named, or its server refused the connection; the plugin runs on
oneOf.x-text: There is no display to show the window on: none was named, or its server refused the connection. The plugin keeps running without a window.

oneOf.title: windowUnsupported
oneOf.description: the plugin has no clap.gui, or its clap.gui offers no window API the host shows, embedded or floating
oneOf.x-text: This plugin has no window, or none in a form this host can show, embedded or floating. Run it without a window.

oneOf.title: windowRefused
oneOf.description: the plugin's clap.gui answered false when asked to create, embed or show its window
oneOf.x-text: The plugin refused to create, embed or show its own window when asked. Run it without a window.

HOSTING_CLAP_CODES.description: The hosting codes of the clap dimension: hosting.clap.*, the verdict and refusal codes a qualifier, a host or the console write and read by code, never by prose (docs/data-layout.md).

oneOf.title: clapExtensionsNotCovered
oneOf.description: unknown: the plugin passed headless with OMX_CLAP_HOST_EXTENSIONS offered, and this host offers fewer of them, so that pass is not this host's; the record names the extensions it lacks
oneOf.x-text: Not every extension this plugin declares is covered by what was checked. Check the plugin against the extensions this host covers, or accept the gap.

oneOf.title: clapFormatNotHosted
oneOf.description: unsuitable: the host profile has no CLAP path (its clapExtensions is null), so no CLAP runs on it whatever was measured
oneOf.x-text: This host does not host the CLAP format. Use a host that does.

oneOf.title: clapHeadlessFailed
oneOf.description: unsuitable: init() or activate() failed with no window and only OMX_CLAP_HOST_EXTENSIONS offered (a plugin that requires the gui extension, or whose init returns false)
oneOf.x-text: The plugin failed while being checked headless, with no window. Fix what failed and check it again.

oneOf.title: clapLatencyMismatch
oneOf.description: unsuitable: at one declared rate the latency the plugin declares is not the frame the qualifier's impulse arrives at (for an instrument, its note sounds before the declared latency); the record names the rate, declared and measured frames
oneOf.x-text: The plugin’s reported latency does not match what was measured. Trust the measured figure, not the plugin’s own report.

oneOf.title: clapNoteInput
oneOf.description: the plugin declares a note input the configuration refuses
oneOf.x-text: This configuration refuses the note input the plugin declares. Run the plugin in a configuration that accepts its note input, or without notes.

oneOf.title: clapProcessError
oneOf.description: unsuitable: process() returned CLAP_PROCESS_ERROR during the parameter or note sweep; the record counts the errors
oneOf.x-text: The plugin’s processing call returned an error. Treat the plugin as faulty for this block.

oneOf.title: clapThreadViolation
oneOf.description: conditional: the strict thread-check caught a [main-thread] host call from the audio thread, or process() on another thread; the plugin runs isolated in a worker of its own
oneOf.x-text: The plugin called back from the wrong thread. Treat the plugin as not thread-safe.

oneOf.title: clapUnqualified
oneOf.description: unknown: no CLAP qualification is on record for the plugin (or its sweep made no process() call), so its topology, features and real-time safety are not judged
oneOf.x-text: This plugin has not been qualified for hosting. Qualify it before relying on it.

HOSTING_COST_CODES.description: The hosting codes of the cost dimension: hosting.cost.*, the verdict and refusal codes a qualifier, a host or the console write and read by code, never by prose (docs/data-layout.md).

oneOf.title: costAboveCeiling
oneOf.description: unsuitable: the plugin's P95 core fraction at the judged rate and quantum is above the host profile's per-instance ceiling
oneOf.x-text: The plugin’s measured CPU cost is above the ceiling for this rate and quantum. Raise the ceiling, or use a plugin that costs less.

oneOf.title: costFieldsMissing
oneOf.description: unknown: the cost record at the judged rate and quantum lacks a figure the comparison needs (refused before comparing, so an absent figure never passes); the record names them
oneOf.x-text: The cost measurement is missing fields it needs. Measure the plugin’s cost again, completely.

oneOf.title: costSpiky
oneOf.description: conditional: the P95 cost per sample is more than the policy's tail ratio above the median at the judged rate and quantum
oneOf.x-text: The plugin’s CPU cost has a spiky tail: occasional blocks cost much more than the rest. Treat it as unreliable at this rate and quantum.

oneOf.title: costUnmeasured
oneOf.description: unknown: no cost was measured at the rate and quantum being judged
oneOf.x-text: The plugin’s CPU cost has not been measured at this rate and quantum. Measure it before relying on a ceiling.

oneOf.title: costWithinCeiling
oneOf.description: suitable: the P95 core fraction is within the host's per-instance ceiling and the tail is within the policy's ratio
oneOf.x-text: The plugin’s measured CPU cost is within the ceiling for this rate and quantum.

HOSTING_FEATURES_CODES.description: The hosting codes of the features dimension: hosting.features.*, the verdict and refusal codes a qualifier, a host or the console write and read by code, never by prose (docs/data-layout.md).

oneOf.title: featuresAtomInUnfed
oneOf.description: a non-MIDI atom input no buffer here can feed
oneOf.x-text: This plugin declares a non-MIDI atom input that nothing here can feed. Run it where that input can be fed, or accept it stays empty.

oneOf.title: featuresDisqualifying
oneOf.description: unsuitable: the plugin requires a feature the host refuses to provide on the audio thread (a disqualifying one, or one that pins the quantum where the quantum is not pinned); the record names them
oneOf.x-text: This plugin needs a host feature this host does not provide. Run it on a host that provides that feature.

oneOf.title: featuresMidiIn
oneOf.description: conditional: the plugin has a MIDI input, which an insert on a host that plays no notes never feeds; on the LV2 path an input the host cannot feed is refused at add
oneOf.x-text: This plugin’s MIDI input is fed nothing. Connect a source of MIDI, or accept it runs with none.

oneOf.title: featuresMissing
oneOf.description: unsuitable: the plugin requires a feature the host does not provide; the LV2 adapter refuses it at add from its TTL, before its binary is opened
oneOf.x-text: This plugin is missing a feature it needs to run here. Provide that feature, or run it elsewhere.

oneOf.title: featuresPortsUnreadable
oneOf.description: the plugin declares ports its reader cannot read (a port node shared by several plugins of one bundle, a port with no symbol), so none reaches the host: the bundle's data is the fault, not the layout (omx-clap-core#255)
oneOf.x-text: This plugin declares ports its reader cannot read, so none of them reach the host. The fault is in the plugin’s own bundle, not in this host.

oneOf.title: featuresProvided
oneOf.description: suitable: every feature the plugin requires is provided, and nothing in its descriptor is a caution
oneOf.x-text: This plugin has every feature it needs.

oneOf.title: featuresUnscanned
oneOf.description: unknown: the plugin's scan record has no feature list, because it was taken before the scan read one
oneOf.x-text: This plugin was scanned before this field existed, so it was never checked for it. Scan it again to check.

HOSTING_LATENCY_CODES.description: The hosting codes of the latency dimension: hosting.latency.*, the verdict and refusal codes a qualifier, a host or the console write and read by code, never by prose (docs/data-layout.md).

oneOf.title: latencyNonconforming
oneOf.description: unknown: the measured latency does not scale with rate as a conforming plugin's does (its scaling class is nonconforming), so its figure is not used
oneOf.x-text: This plugin’s reported latency does not conform to what a host can use. Don’t trust its reported latency.

oneOf.title: latencyParameterDependent
oneOf.description: conditional: the parameter sweep moved the plugin's latency; allowed where the host compensates, as it reads the live figure each cycle
oneOf.x-text: This plugin’s latency changes with its parameters. Re-read its latency after a parameter change that could affect it.

oneOf.title: latencyResolved
oneOf.description: suitable: the plugin's latency is measured and fixed (for a CLAP, the declared figure is what was measured at every declared rate)
oneOf.x-text: This plugin’s latency has been resolved to a fixed figure.

oneOf.title: latencyUnmeasured
oneOf.description: unknown: there is no latency figure, or the benchmark declared it unmeasurable; fails closed, never passed by default
oneOf.x-text: This plugin’s latency has not been measured. Measure it before relying on it.

HOSTING_MEMORY_CODES.description: The hosting codes of the memory dimension: hosting.memory.*, what a qualifier, a host or the console read of a plugin's measured memory against a host's budget, by code, never by prose.

oneOf.title: memoryAboveCeiling
oneOf.description: the measured figure passes the host's budget for one instance or for all its plugins; the params name the figure, the ceiling, and whether the ceiling is provisional
oneOf.x-text: This plugin’s measured memory is above the host’s budget. Raise the budget, or use a plugin that uses less memory.

oneOf.title: memoryUnmeasured
oneOf.description: no figure at the host's rate and quantum, so the plugin is not known to fit; a missing figure never reads as fitting
oneOf.x-text: This plugin’s memory has not been measured at the host’s rate and quantum, so it is not known to fit. Measure it before trusting that it fits.

oneOf.title: memoryWithinCeiling
oneOf.description: the measured figure fits a budget that was itself measured on that kind of host
oneOf.x-text: This plugin’s measured memory fits a budget that was itself measured on this kind of host.

oneOf.title: memoryWithinProvisionalCeiling
oneOf.description: the measured figure is under a budget not yet measured on that kind of host, so this says the figure and the ceiling, not that the plugin fits
oneOf.x-text: This plugin’s measured memory is under a budget that has not yet been measured on this kind of host. This is not a guarantee that it fits, only that it is under that provisional budget.

HOSTING_OUTPUT_CODES.description: The hosting codes of the output dimension: hosting.output.*, the verdict and refusal codes a qualifier, a host or the console write and read by code, never by prose (docs/data-layout.md).

oneOf.title: outputNonFinite
oneOf.description: the plugin produced non-finite output
oneOf.x-text: This plugin produced non-finite output: infinities or NaNs. Treat its output as a fault.

HOSTING_OVERRIDE_CODES.description: The hosting codes of the override dimension: hosting.override.*, the verdict and refusal codes a qualifier, a host or the console write and read by code, never by prose (docs/data-layout.md).

oneOf.title: overrideIsolated
oneOf.description: unsuitable: the curator's override holds the plugin isolated, whatever its measurements say
oneOf.x-text: The curator’s override is isolated from this run. Apply the override where the curator’s run can see it.

HOSTING_PATCH_CODES.description: The hosting codes of the patch dimension: hosting.patch.*, the verdict and refusal codes a qualifier, a host or the console write and read by code, never by prose (docs/data-layout.md).

oneOf.title: patchBusy
oneOf.description: a patch write found the previous one not yet taken by the plugin's thread; the host retries it for a while before answering this
oneOf.x-text: The plugin’s patch is busy right now. Try again once it’s free.

oneOf.title: patchNotWritable
oneOf.description: the plugin lists no such writable property, or the adapter did not create it: a patch write is refused
oneOf.x-text: This plugin’s patch cannot be written. Treat it as read-only.

oneOf.title: patchTooLarge
oneOf.description: the value of a patch write is longer than the property's max_bytes
oneOf.x-text: This patch is too large for the plugin to accept. Use a smaller patch.

HOSTING_PRESET_CODES.description: The hosting codes of the preset dimension: hosting.preset.*, the verdict and refusal codes a qualifier, a host or the console write and read by code, never by prose (docs/data-layout.md).

oneOf.title: presetNotFound
oneOf.description: the bundle holds no preset of that name for this plugin
oneOf.x-text: This preset could not be found. Check its name and location and try again.

HOSTING_PROVENANCE_CODES.description: The hosting codes of the provenance dimension: hosting.provenance.*, the verdict and refusal codes a qualifier, a host or the console write and read by code, never by prose (docs/data-layout.md).

oneOf.title: hostProvenanceDiffers
oneOf.description: unknown: the figures were measured on a host other than the one the console runs on, so no verdict is carried over from them
oneOf.x-text: The host that measured this plugin differs from the one running it now. Measure it again on this host, or accept the difference.

oneOf.title: sweepControlDidNotFire
oneOf.description: unknown: the sweep's positive control did not fire, so nothing the sweep measured counts
oneOf.x-text: The sweep’s control plugin did not fire during the measurement. Check the control plugin and measure again.

HOSTING_REALISED_CODES.description: What the console did with a plugin's verdict: hosting.realised.* and the outcomes with no dimension (hosting.disabled, hosting.unjudged, hosting.no-realisation, hosting.linked), read by code, never by prose.

oneOf.title: disabled
oneOf.description: the console's in-process switch is off: an LV2 runs isolated, and a third-party CLAP, which has no other path, is refused
oneOf.x-text: This plugin is disabled. Enable it before using it.

oneOf.title: linked
oneOf.description: the plugin is one of the engine's statically linked CLAPs and runs in-process on the node that carries the CLAP bank
oneOf.x-text: This plugin is realised linked into the host’s own process.

oneOf.title: noRealisation
oneOf.description: the plugin earned a path that has no body here: no LV2 adapter or CLAP bank to run it, or a port class the stage cannot bind
oneOf.x-text: This plugin has no realisation: nothing runs it. Give it a way to run before using it.

oneOf.title: realisedInProcess
oneOf.description: the plugin runs in-process: it earned it and the console's switch allows it
oneOf.x-text: This plugin is realised in its own process, isolated from the host’s.

oneOf.title: unjudged
oneOf.description: the plugin has no verdict on record for this build (a linked CLAP without a row measured on the pinned build): it is refused at load
oneOf.x-text: This plugin has not been judged yet. Judge it before trusting any verdict about it.

HOSTING_RESOURCE_HINTS_CODES.description: The hosting codes of the resource-hints dimension: hosting.resource-hints.*, why the host refuses the hints a plugin declares about itself (omx-contract's RESOURCE_HINTS, through the CLAP draft org.openmixer.resource-hints.draft/0 or the omxres LV2 properties). A refused declaration is trusted for none of its hints: every hint reads as unknown.

oneOf.title: resourceHintsOutOfRange
oneOf.description: a figure below zero, or past what its hint's member holds
oneOf.x-text: This plugin declared a resource hint figure below zero, or past what that hint can hold. None of its hints are trusted; every one reads as unknown.

oneOf.title: resourceHintsUnknownHint
oneOf.description: the declared mask sets a bit RESOURCE_HINTS has no hint for
oneOf.x-text: This plugin’s declared hints set a bit that names no known hint. None of its hints are trusted; every one reads as unknown.

oneOf.title: resourceHintsWrongUnit
oneOf.description: a figure not in its hint's unit: a flag that is not a boolean, a count, a time or a size that is not an integer
oneOf.x-text: This plugin declared a resource hint figure in the wrong unit: a flag that is not a boolean, or a count, time or size that is not a whole number. None of its hints are trusted; every one reads as unknown.

HOSTING_RT_SAFETY_CODES.description: The hosting codes of the rt-safety dimension: hosting.rt-safety.*, the verdict and refusal codes a qualifier, a host or the console write and read by code, never by prose (docs/data-layout.md).

oneOf.title: rtSafetyClean
oneOf.description: suitable: the interposer counted no allocation, lock or system call on the audio thread over the armed blocks with every parameter swept
oneOf.x-text: The plugin showed no real-time safety violation under the sweep. It passed clean.

oneOf.title: rtSafetyNotReproducible
oneOf.description: unknown: the interposer's counts varied between runs of the same plugin
oneOf.x-text: The real-time safety measurement could not be reproduced. Measure it again before trusting it.

oneOf.title: rtSafetyNotesClean
oneOf.description: suitable: played under the interposer, the plugin made no allocation, lock or system call
oneOf.x-text: The plugin showed no real-time safety violation while playing notes. It passed clean.

oneOf.title: rtSafetyNotesUnmeasured
oneOf.description: unknown: the plugin takes notes and was not played under the interposer; the parameter sweep alone says nothing about a voice
oneOf.x-text: The plugin’s real-time safety while playing notes has not been measured. Measure it before relying on it.

oneOf.title: rtSafetyNotesViolations
oneOf.description: conditional: played under the interposer, the plugin allocated, locked or made a system call; it runs in a worker of its own
oneOf.x-text: The plugin violated real-time safety while playing notes. Treat it as not real-time safe with notes.

oneOf.title: rtSafetyOwnThreads
oneOf.description: conditional: the plugin started threads of its own at instantiate (counted from /proc/self/task); a worker thread is not RT-unsafe, so the plugin still shares a worker (D20)
oneOf.x-text: The plugin starts threads of its own beside its audio. It is real-time safe, and it can share a worker; its threads share the cores with the audio.

oneOf.title: rtSafetyUnmeasured
oneOf.description: unknown: no interposer count was taken with every parameter swept (or the plugin has none to sweep), so the audio thread was never traced
oneOf.x-text: The plugin’s real-time safety has not been measured. Measure it before relying on it.

oneOf.title: rtSafetyViolations
oneOf.description: conditional: the interposer counted allocations, locks or system calls on the audio thread over the armed blocks; the plugin runs in a worker of its own, never grouped with RT-safe plugins
oneOf.x-text: The plugin violated real-time safety during the run. Treat it as not real-time safe.

HOSTING_STABILITY_CODES.description: The hosting codes of the stability dimension: hosting.stability.*, the verdict and refusal codes a qualifier, a host or the console write and read by code, never by prose (docs/data-layout.md).

oneOf.title: stabilityBelowFloor
oneOf.description: unknown: the plugin was instantiated fewer times than the policy's cycle floor
oneOf.x-text: The plugin was soaked for fewer cycles than the floor needs. Soak it for enough cycles before trusting the result.

oneOf.title: stabilityCrashUnattributed
oneOf.description: unknown: a crash was recorded that no signature attributes to the plugin
oneOf.x-text: Something crashed during the run, but not a plugin that could be identified. Narrow down which plugin crashed before trusting any of them.

oneOf.title: stabilityCrashedAttributed
oneOf.description: unsuitable: a recorded crash is attributed to the plugin's own binary
oneOf.x-text: This plugin crashed during the run. Don’t host it until it’s fixed.

oneOf.title: stabilityCalleeSavedClobbered
oneOf.description: the plugin returned from a call with a callee-saved register changed (0.26.2): the host's guard put it back, but not the other members' state in the same process, so the plugin runs only in a worker of its own
oneOf.x-text: This plugin returned from a call having changed a register it should have preserved. The host put the register back, but other plugins sharing its process were not protected, so it now runs only in a worker of its own.

oneOf.title: stabilityCrashedLive
oneOf.description: the plugin crashed live on this rig
oneOf.x-text: This plugin crashed live on this rig. Don’t host it on this rig until it’s fixed.

oneOf.title: stabilityLinksGuiToolkit
oneOf.description: conditional: the plugin links a GUI toolkit, a caution only where it shares a process
oneOf.x-text: This plugin links a GUI toolkit, which this host does not run headless. Run it where a GUI toolkit is safe, or use a plugin without one.

oneOf.title: stabilitySoakFailedAtRate
oneOf.description: unsuitable: the soak failed at the very rate being judged (a supervisor timeout aside, which is the harness's)
oneOf.x-text: The plugin failed its soak test at this sample rate. Don’t trust it at this rate until it’s fixed.

oneOf.title: stabilitySoaked
oneOf.description: suitable: the plugin cleared the cycle floor and the soak, with no crash and no caution
oneOf.x-text: The plugin completed its soak test. It held up over the run.

oneOf.title: stabilitySpawnsThreads
oneOf.description: conditional: the plugin spawns threads, a caution only where it shares a process
oneOf.x-text: This plugin spawns its own threads. Watch it for behaviour a host does not control.

oneOf.title: stabilityUnmeasured
oneOf.description: unknown: no lifecycle measurement is on record
oneOf.x-text: This plugin’s stability has not been measured. Measure it before relying on it.

oneOf.title: stabilityUnsoaked
oneOf.description: unknown: the soak ran for less than the policy's time, did not sweep the parameters, or failed at some rate
oneOf.x-text: This plugin has not been soaked. Soak it before trusting it over a long run.

HOSTING_STATE_CODES.description: The hosting codes of the state dimension: hosting.state.*, the verdict and refusal codes a qualifier, a host or the console write and read by code, never by prose (docs/data-layout.md).

oneOf.title: stateNotACopy
oneOf.description: not a save's copy directory of the root
oneOf.x-text: This path is not a save’s copy directory of the state root. Use the copy directory a save actually made.

oneOf.title: statePathOnAudio
oneOf.description: makePath: called on the audio role
oneOf.x-text: This path was requested from the audio role, where it cannot be made. Request it from outside the audio role.

oneOf.title: statePathOutside
oneOf.description: makePath: empty, absolute, or a `..` component
oneOf.x-text: This path is empty, absolute, or steps outside with a `..` component. Use a path relative to the state root, with no `..`.

oneOf.title: statePathSymlink
oneOf.description: makePath: a component is a symbolic link
oneOf.x-text: A component of this path is a symbolic link, which is not allowed here. Use a path with no symbolic links.

oneOf.title: statePathTooLong
oneOf.description: makePath: PATH_MAX or more, or a long component
oneOf.x-text: This path, or one of its components, is too long. Use a shorter path.

oneOf.title: statePathUnmakeable
oneOf.description: makePath: a directory could not be made
oneOf.x-text: The directory for this path could not be made. Check that the state root is writable and try again.

oneOf.title: stateUnreadable
oneOf.description: the plugin does not declare the state feature, has no state interface, or its restore failed
oneOf.x-text: This plugin’s saved state could not be read. Treat it as lost, or restore it from a working copy.

HOSTING_TOPOLOGY_CODES.description: The hosting codes of the topology dimension: hosting.topology.*, the verdict and refusal codes a qualifier, a host or the console write and read by code, never by prose (docs/data-layout.md).

oneOf.title: topologyAmbisonicConfig
oneOf.description: an ambisonic port refuses the carrier's ordering or normalisation
oneOf.x-text: This plugin’s ambisonic port refuses the carrier’s channel ordering or normalisation. Use a carrier whose ordering and normalisation this port accepts.

oneOf.title: topologyChannelMapUnknown
oneOf.description: a surround port names a channel id the host does not know, or refuses the carrier's channel mask
oneOf.x-text: This plugin’s surround port names a channel this host does not know, or refuses the carrier’s channel mask. Use a carrier whose channels this host recognises.

oneOf.title: topologyInstrument
oneOf.description: suitable: on a host that plays notes, the plugin has no audio input, a note or MIDI input and an audio output (one or two channels for a CLAP)
oneOf.x-text: This plugin is hosted as an instrument: it has no audio input of its own.

oneOf.title: topologyMatched
oneOf.description: suitable: the plugin's main audio ports are mono to mono or stereo to stereo, with no sidechain input
oneOf.x-text: This plugin’s ports match the topology it is hosted on.

oneOf.title: topologyNoAudioInput
oneOf.description: the plugin has no audio input
oneOf.x-text: This plugin has no audio input.

oneOf.title: topologyNoAudioOutput
oneOf.description: the host has nothing of the plugin to carry: a CLAP plugin with an audio input or an auxiliary port and no main output, an LV2 plugin with no port at all (any other plugin with no audio output is hosted as a pass-through tool)
oneOf.x-text: This plugin has nothing for the host to carry on its output: it declares an audio input or auxiliary port but no main output. Use a plugin with a main audio output, or run it as a pass-through tool.

oneOf.title: topologyPortTooWide
oneOf.description: a port of more channels than the limit, or an ambisonic port whose channels are not (order+1)²
oneOf.x-text: This plugin’s port has more channels than the limit, or its ambisonic channel count is not valid for its order. Use a plugin whose ports stay within the channel limit.

oneOf.title: topologyPortWithoutChannels
oneOf.description: a port of zero channels
oneOf.x-text: This plugin declares a port with zero channels. Fix the plugin’s port declaration before hosting it.

oneOf.title: topologyTooManyPorts
oneOf.description: more than the limit of auxiliary ports on one side, or more than one main port on a side
oneOf.x-text: This plugin declares more auxiliary ports than the limit on one side, or more than one main port on a side. Use a plugin within the port limits.

oneOf.title: topologyWiderThanStrip
oneOf.description: a main port is wider than the lane the caller runs the plugin on
oneOf.x-text: This plugin’s main port is wider than the strip it runs on. Run it on a strip wide enough for its main port.

HOSTING_WORKER_CODES.description: The hosting codes of the worker dimension: hosting.worker.*, the verdict and refusal codes a qualifier, a host or the console write and read by code, never by prose (docs/data-layout.md).

oneOf.title: workerNonconforming
oneOf.description: unsuitable: the plugin's worker interface was refused while its latency was measured, so it is not hostable
oneOf.x-text: This plugin’s worker does not conform to what a worker must do. Don’t rely on its worker.
